On Wed, 2015-03-18 at 11:49 -0700, Amanda Waclawczyk wrote:
> Good afternoon, the model I am trying to run will not work. Can you
> help me figure out the problem?
>

Hi,

I guess you run out of memory. can you try to reun with

inla(..., num.threads=1, control.inla=list(int.strategy="eb",
strategy="gaussian"))

just to see if its able to compute it?

does it work with less data?

H
